A.text: A charged particle having charge q and mass m moves rectilinearly under the action of an electric field E(x) = (4 − 3x) N/C where x is the distance in metre from the point where the particle was initially at rest. A.subject: Physics
A.text:
Three same sized magnets of magnetic moments M, 2M and 3M are placed in such a way that they form an equilateral triangle as shown.

The resultant magnetic moment of the system is
A.sol_text:
Answer: (3)
Solution:
Net magnetic moment can be obtained by vector addition of the individual moments.

Vector diagram shows:
- Moment M pointing to the right (along positive x-axis)
- Moment 2M pointing at 60° above the horizontal
- Moment 3M pointing downward at 60° below the horizontal

Components:
- Horizontal components: M + 2M cos(60°) + 3M cos(60°) = M + 2M(1/2) + 3M(1/2) = M + M + (3M/2) = (3M/2) (net rightward)
- Vertical components: 2M sin(60°) - 3M sin(60°) = 2M(√3/2) - 3M(√3/2) = M√3 - (3M√3/2) = -(√3M/2) (net downward)

M_net = √[(3M/2)² + (√3M/2)²] = √[(9M²/4) + (3M²/4)] = √(12M²/4) = √(3M²) = √3 M

⇒ T_h = T_c

B.text: An infinite grid is made of identical capacitors of capacitance C₀ each as shown in figure. The equivalent capacitance between points A and B is given by (nC₀)/3. Find the value of n.
B.sol_text:
By superposition method, Let charge Q enters at A and it gets distributed equally in four branches.
∴ q_AB = Q/4
Now let Q charge comes out from point B, then charges get collected equally from four branches.
∴ q_AB = Q/4
∴ By superposition,
Q_net(AB) = Q/4 + Q/4 = Q/2
And Q = C_eq × V
⇒ (C_eq × V)/2 = C₀ × V
⇒ C_eq = 2C₀

A.text: The number of P – OH bonds and the oxidation state of phosphorus atom in pyrophosphoric acid (H₄P₂O₇) respectively are:
A.sol_text:

Structure shown with two phosphorus atoms connected by P-O-P bridge, with one P having double-bonded O and OH groups, the other P also having double-bonded O and OH groups.

From the structure of pyrophosphoric acid (H₄P₂O₇):
